name: join low-degree pieces with matching derivatives at the knots
mechanism: use a separate low-degree polynomial on each interval between samples, and choose their coefficients so that values and the first few derivatives agree where pieces meet; smoothness comes from the joins, not from a high degree

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Spline interpolation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation: Reduces error with Runge's phenomenon.
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bicubic interpolation': a generalization of cubic interpolation to two dimensions
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Tricubic interpolation': a generalization of cubic interpolation to three dimensions

fails_when: overshoot near steep data; a change in one sample moves the whole curve (for natural splines)
